newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end higher at 24.125 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end higher at 24.125 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended above opening levels but below Friday's closing rates in active trading on the first day of the new two-week reserve period, dealers said.

Overnight rates closed at 24.125 percent, compared to 25.25 percent at Friday's close and at 23.50 percent at today's opening. "The market was rather active," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank. "Many banks were likely boosting their reserves as we approach the end of the year."
Dealers also said recent tax payments may have had an impact on today's rates.
Kaiser said she expected the rest of the year to be active as Hungarian companies settle their accounts.
